name: Grave Bite
flavour: Poison is only a slow kind of bite.
note: Claw: life on hit, crit, 60% poison and physical converted to chaos.

name: Totem of the Pack
flavour: Everything that hunts is honoured here.
note: Increased damage of every type on an amulet.

name: Open-Fist Mitts
flavour: Faster when whole, faster when dying.
note: Attack speed on full life, movement speed on low life, added lightning and accuracy.

name: Tidepool Ring
flavour: Small, bright and slightly wet.
note: Intelligence with percentage life and energy shield.

name: Wellspring Ring
flavour: A cold, quiet spring at the top of the climb.
note: Sibling of the Tidepool ring.

name: Reedwater Ring
flavour: Where the water goes to think.
note: Sibling of the Tidepool ring.

name: Prism Treads
flavour: Every colour of danger, underfoot.
note: Spell block, mana, energy shield, all resistances and movement speed on boots.

name: Penitent Blade
flavour: It strikes with every kind of regret.
note: Added damage of all five types and attack speed on a sword.

name: Wolfhowl Blade
flavour: Its owner never walks into a room.
note: Accuracy, physical damage, attack speed and movement speed.

name: Singed Wool Gloves
flavour: Soft, scorched and lucky.
note: Added fire and lightning to attacks, energy shield and item quantity.

name: Longstride Boots
flavour: The road is shorter in these.
note: Fifty percent movement speed and nothing else.

name: Scholar's Quickstep
flavour: Study on the move.
note: Energy shield and intelligence with movement speed, more on full life.

name: Frostneedle Sword
flavour: A thin cold line, drawn quickly.
note: Added cold, accuracy and mana leech, and immunity to freeze.

name: Moonwood Bow
flavour: Drawn in silence and loosed in silver.
note: Gem levels (all and bow), physical damage, attack speed and mana on kill.

name: Moonwood Switch
flavour: A young branch, already straight.
note: A lower sibling: bow gem level, physical damage, attack speed and mana on kill.

name: Snakeskin Grips
flavour: Slippery to hold and hard to get loose from.
note: Dexterity, evasion, attack speed and attack leech.

name: Wardstone of Calm
flavour: The mind does not move, so nothing moves it.
note: Spell block, cast speed and mana.

name: Solstice Treads
flavour: The longest day is still too short.
note: Evasion, attack speed, item rarity, fire resistance and movement speed.

name: Burnished Fob
flavour: A small warm lie.
note: Added fire to attacks, accuracy, evasion and fire resistance.

name: Cinder Staff
flavour: It never quite stops burning.
note: Fire gem level, spell and fire damage, burning damage, cast speed and staff block.

name: Beacon Quiver
flavour: Light it, and the whole ridge answers.
note: Physical converted and gained as fire, added fire to bow attacks and attack speed.

name: Gospel Sceptre
flavour: Plain, absolute and unwelcome.
note: Elemental and physical damage, attack speed, gem level and experience.

name: Lopsided Pendant
flavour: Fine until you press it.
note: Doubled crit chance for less crit multiplier, life, mana and stun recovery.

name: Brightwater Ring
flavour: Quick on the draw and quicker on the shore.
note: Dexterity with percentage life and energy shield.

name: Highwater Ring
flavour: Cold air and thin patience.
note: Sibling of the Brightwater ring.

name: Lowwater Ring
flavour: Where the first rain pools.
note: Sibling of the Brightwater ring.

name: Twin-charge Pendant
flavour: Two kinds of hurry, one throat.
note: Frenzy and Power charges on kill, with projectile speed and damage per charge.

name: Hollow Capacitor
flavour: It stores what it has not yet felt.
note: Power charges raise spell damage, with a penalty to base spell damage and big spell crit.

name: Plain Setting
flavour: It holds nothing, so it lifts everything.
note: Five levels of socketed gems on a ring.

name: Pauper's Maul
flavour: It makes a terrible bargain.
note: Heavy mace with fast attacks and big damage, paid for with rarity and experience.

name: Footloose Shoes
flavour: The road wants you back.
note: Movement speed, mana regeneration, energy shield and immunity to freeze.

name: Lucky Snare
flavour: A mess of springs and one bright idea.
note: All attributes, energy shield, movement speed and huge item rarity on low life.

name: Stormcaller's Pole
flavour: The sky is always listening.
note: Lightning gem level, lightning damage, shock chance and penetration on a staff.

name: Stormcaller's Rod
flavour: It points at the next storm.
note: Lightning gem level, lightning damage, added spell lightning and penetration on a staff.
